capabilities: Render VitePress ::: alert and details containers as cards and collapsible elements
Group consecutive code blocks into a tabbed switcher
Add language labels and filename display to code blocks
Restyle Obsidian Callouts with VitePress colors
Apply VitePress typography, table, badge, emoji, and relative-link styles
disambiguation: Not a pure CSS theme; it also parses VitePress ::: container syntax, but only in Reading Mode.
extras: VitePress-specific syntax (::: containers, badges, code groups) renders only in Reading Mode; Live Preview and Source Mode are intentionally left unprocessed. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Native Obsidian Callouts are automatically styled to match VitePress colors
problem: Obsidian has no support for VitePress-specific syntax like ::: containers, code groups, or [filename] code blocks, and its default look differs from VitePress docs.

relations.evidence: A VitePress-style theme plugin for Obsidian, bringing the modern documentation aesthetic and syntax to your notes.

summary: Theme that styles notes in VitePress documentation aesthetics, rendering ::: alert containers, code groups, badges, and matching typography.
